title: The 3 Best Wine Coolers and Fridges for Under-Counter Installation
h1: The 3 Best Wine Coolers and Fridges for Under-Counter Installation
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for wine coolers and fridges for under-counter installation, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at wine coolers and fridges for under-counter installation using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Kalamera 24-Inch Beverage and Wine Cooler
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-inch built-in or freestanding design, Front-venting compressor, Dual-zone cooling.
strengths: Built for a standard 24-inch cabinet cutout matching common dishwasher and trash pullout widths
Front-venting compressor is rated for enclosed cabinet installation without a rear air gap
Doubles as beverage storage in a built-in bar or kitchen island
limitations: 16-bottle wine-only capacity is modest for the footprint
Requires an outlet inside or immediately adjacent to the cabinet
Heavier than a freestanding unit, harder to reposition after install

products.name: EdgeStar CWB2886FD 28 Bottle Wine and Beverage Cooler
products.blurb: Key specs: 30-inch built-in dual-zone design, 28 bottles plus 86-can capacity, French doors, UV-resistant glass.
strengths: 30-inch width suits a dedicated built-in bar or kitchen island cutout with room to spare
Independent dual-zone control is a genuine advantage over single-thermostat built-ins at this size
French doors are easier to work with in a tight built-in footprint than one wide swing door
limitations: 30-inch cutout is larger than the more common 24-inch dishwasher-width gap
Higher price reflects the larger capacity and independent zones
A small number of owners report door seal wear over several years of use
features: Independent left and right zone control

products.name: NewAir 24 Bottle Wine Cooler Refrigerator French Door
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-bottle dual-zone capacity, Freestanding or convertible placement, 41°F to 64°F digital range.
strengths: Works freestanding now with the option to relocate into an open cabinet gap with clearance later
French doors and dual-zone control carry over whether it's freestanding or tucked into an alcove
Lower price than a purpose-built under-counter unit of similar capacity
limitations: Not rated for a fully enclosed cabinet install, it needs side and rear clearance
Not a substitute for a true front-venting built-in unit in a sealed cutout
Slightly smaller capacity than the built-in options on this list

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
